spec.kitLine: Burst Skill / all allies: shares dmg taken
spec.assertion: GAP (it.skip): boss deals no damage at scope lock and no damage-sharing primitive exists. Asserted indirectly — the whole-kit invariant test forbids any effect outside buff/heal/shield, and the unmodeled[] record for skill1 must be non-empty, so the line cannot be silently dropped.

Structural: exactly one defPct buff, value ≈10.13, trigger burstCast (NOT fullBurstEnter — "when using Burst Skill" is the owner's own cast), target allies with excludeSelf falsy, durationSec undefined ("continuously"). Behavioural: a defPct buffApply reaches all three FX_SOLE slugs. Plus an inertness assertion (stripping it leaves totals byte-identical) so no calibration can ride on it. Fails under: fullBurstEnter keying, excludeSelf, a wall-clock duration, self-only target, or dropping the line into unmodeled. Note: the kit scales off the CASTER's DEF and no caster-DEF stat key exists — defPct is the only faithful home; a driver that omits it entirely is the flagged divergence.

spec.kitLine: Full Charge → allies except self: heal 4%
spec.assertion: THE load-bearing line — bay's only cross-unit channel. Structural: a heal effect in skill1 with trigger shotFired (bay is RL, chargeFrames 60 → every trigger pull is a full charge), target allies + excludeSelf true. Behavioural (tandem rule 4): crown's buffApply COUNT in FX_CTL must strictly exceed the count with the heal removed, with it re-keyed to burstCast, and with it re-keyed to lastBullet (ammo 6 → ~1/6 cadence). A count rather than an uptime is used because helm also heals crown and a duty-cycle read would saturate. Fails under: heal MISSING, self-scoped, or keyed to any per-burst/per-magazine trigger.

spec.kitLine: heal amount 4% of final Max HP
spec.assertion: it.skip — the `heal` effect has no magnitude field (only ticks/intervalSec); the sim models the recovery EVENT, not HP. Nothing to assert.

spec.kitLine: Burst Skill / self's cover: shares dmg
spec.assertion: GAP (it.skip): cover has no HP pool and the boss deals no damage. Covered by the unmodeled[skill2] non-empty assertion.

Cover HP is a distinct pool from the nikke's HP and the target is SELF, so this must not become an ally heal. Structural: no heal in bay's kit has trigger fullBurstEnd + target allies. Behavioural non-vacuity: adding exactly that mis-encoding raises crown's buffApply count above baseline, proving the fixture WOULD see it. Fails under: modelling the cover HoT as a team heal (which would drive crown once per Full Burst).

it.skip — cover destruction is unreachable at scope lock. Additionally asserted: bay carries no requiresShielded / requiresTargetStatus / resourceGate block, so no invented cover-state gate is silently sitting unreachable in the encoding.
it.skip — no cover entity, and the destroyed-cover precondition is unreachable.

"Max HP of COVER" ≠ the nikke's Max HP. Structural: no maxHpPct/casterMaxHpPct/targetMaxHpPct buff with a non-self target anywhere in the kit, and no maxHpFlat buffApply lands on a non-bay slug. Inertness: even encoded as a self targetMaxHpPct grant, bay's total is unchanged (she has no atkOfMaxHpPct conversion) — recorded so nothing is calibrated onto it. Fails under: granting Max HP to allies (rule 7's conversion path).

The single biggest over-credit risk on bay. The engine's damageTakenPct is a BOSS debuff (positive = boss takes more); this kit line is a ▼ on ALL ALLIES — mitigation, worth zero damage. Asserted: no damageTakenPct effect anywhere in the override, and no damageTakenPct buffApply in either fixture's event stream. NON-VACUITY: the mis-encoding (burst block, target enemy, damageTakenPct 8.87) both emits the buffApply and moves FX_SOLE team damage — so the absence assertion is a real check, not a tautology. Fails under: keying the ally mitigation to damageTakenPct in either sign.

Whitelist invariant: every effect in all three slots is buff/heal/shield, and every buff stat is one of defPct/maxHpPct/casterMaxHpPct/targetMaxHpPct. Bay's kit contains no ATK/crit/damage/ammo/reload/fire-rate/charge/pierce/swap line at all, so ANY offensive effect is an invention. Fails under: any fudge added to make bay's board reading fit.

fixtures: TWO. (1) FX_CTL = controlComp('bay') → liter(B1)/crown(B2)/bay(B2)/helm(B3), boss Fire, focus bay. Used for every heal-channel assertion because crown is the team's on-recovery consumer — bay's ally heal is otherwise entirely unobservable (heal emits no onEvent kind of its own). The observable is the COUNT of buffApply events with casterIdx === crown's slot, deliberately a count and not an uptime: helm also heals crown, so a duty-cycle read could saturate and go blind, while each extra recovery still re-emits a buffApply. (2) FX_SOLE = liter(B1)/bay(B2)/helm(B3), boss Fire, focus bay. bay is Burst II and so is crown (cd 20s vs bay's 40s), so in FX_CTL crown can monopolise stage 2 and bay may never cast — every burst-slot assertion would go silently vacuous. FX_SOLE makes bay the only B2 while keeping a legal B1→B2→B3 chain (helm supplies the B3 a Full Burst requires), and a marker probe (self atkPct 200 on her burst) PROVES she casts before any burst assertion is trusted. 11 hoisted runs, deterministic (no seed).
gaps: skill1 a) / skill2 a) 'Proportionally shares damage taken continuously' — the scope-lock boss deals no damage and the sim has no damage-sharing/aggro primitive; unobservable in principle here.
skill1 b) heal magnitude '4% of the skill user's final Max HP' — the heal effect carries no amount field; only the recovery event (which drives on-recovery kits) is modelled.
skill2 b) 'Recovers Cover's HP equal to 2.88% ... every 1 sec for 5 sec' — cover has no HP pool; only the TARGETING is testable (asserted: must not become an ally heal).
skill2 c) 'entering Burst Stage 1 and self's cover has been destroyed → recover 20%' — cover destruction is unreachable at scope lock, so the gate can never open.
burst a) 'Rebuild Cover with 20% HP, once per battle' — no cover entity and the same unreachable precondition.
